requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Gender & Health
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Gender & Health department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: Prerequisite: Perspectives in Women's Health
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: WGS 220 (listed as WOMENSTD 220 on the audit) or NURS 220.

requirements.label: Feminist Theory Seminar
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better. One of WGS 330 (Feminist Thought) or WGS 331 (Feminist Theoretical Perspectives in Gender and Health), per the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024.

requirements.label: Practicum
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better. Counts the practicum courses named in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024: WGS 310 (only if elected FA 2023 or later), WGS 350, WGS 351, WGS 353, WGS 384 (independent research, by department advisor approval), WGS 404 / HS 404, and specifically approved SOC 225 Project Community topics. The bulletin list is not exhaustive; other immersive gender and health experiences can qualify with instructor and department approval.

requirements.label: Thematic Area: LGBTQ and Sexuality Studies in Health
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better, from the LGBTQ and Sexuality Studies in Health list in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024. Some entries count only for specific sections or terms, such as WGS 314 (The Culture of AIDS), WGS 415 (only if elected FA 2023 or later), WGS 432 (Diagnosis, Sex and Society or LGBTQ Reproductive Health), and SOC 495 (Diagnosis, Sex and Society). A course cannot double count across thematic areas.

requirements.label: Thematic Area: Critical Race and Ethnic Studies in Gender & Health
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better, from the Critical Race and Ethnic Studies in Gender and Health list in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024. Some entries count only for specific sections, such as WGS 341 (Black Queer Histories) and certain WGS 343 topics. A course cannot double count across thematic areas.

requirements.label: Thematic Area: Gender & Health in Bioscience
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better, from the Gender and Health in Bioscience list in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024. Some entries count only for specific sections or terms, such as WGS 333 (only if elected SP 2023 or later), WGS 342 (Biomedical Knowledge: Behavior, Science and Gender), and WGS 432 (Gender and Contested Illness). A course cannot double count across thematic areas.

requirements.label: Thematic Area: Gender & Health in Global, Transnational, or Historical Perspectives
requirements.hint: Minimum 1 course, C- or better, from the Gender and Health in Global, Transnational, or Historical Perspectives list in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024. Some entries count only for specific sections or terms, such as WGS 213 (War, Gender, Masculinity, Violence), WGS 342 (named sections), WGS 345 (Sexual Violence and the State), WGS 377 (In Sickness and in Health), and WGS 432 (named sections). A course cannot double count across thematic areas.

requirements.label: 27 Credits in the Major (excluding prerequisites)
requirements.hint: Minimum 3 elective courses plus enough courses to complete 27 credits in the major. Planner counts WGS courses; approved non-WGS courses used toward major requirements also count, and the WGS 220 or NURS 220 prerequisite does not. The WGS 220 prerequisite is excluded from this count per the audit.

requirements.label: Electives: minimum 3 courses
requirements.hint: C- or better per course. WGS courses beyond the core and thematic requirements; approved courses from other departments can also count with department approval (planner counts WGS courses).

requirements.label: Gender, Culture, and Representation
requirements.hint: 1 course from the Thematic Areas or Electives must meet this requirement, C- or better. Counts the Gender, Culture and Representation list in the LSA bulletin Gender and Health major requirements, effective Summer 2024. Some entries count only for specific sections or terms, such as ENGLISH 317 (Disability Culture), WGS 310 and WGS 484 (only if elected FA 2023 or later), and named WGS 313, WGS 314, WGS 342, and WGS 432 sections.

requirements.label: Cognate: 6 Credits outside WGS
requirements.hint: 6 credits (2 courses) outside Women's and Gender Studies, C- or better per course. May NOT use WGS or any course crosslisted with WGS, should sit in a single discipline, and requires WGS advisor approval. The planner counts any non-WGS course; it cannot check the no-crosslist rule or advisor approval, so confirm your cognates with an advisor.

requirements.label: Cognate: 2 Courses
requirements.hint: The 6 cognate credits must come from at least 2 courses, C- or better per course. The planner counts any non-WGS course; it cannot check the no-crosslist rule or advisor approval, so confirm your cognates with an advisor.

requirements.label: Ann Arbor Campus Requirement: 14 Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 14 credits of major course work taken on the Ann Arbor campus. STDABRD courses do not count.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: 33
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments. Does not include any prerequisites. Planner counts WGS courses. The WGS 220 prerequisite is excluded from this count per the audit.
